testcase.name: Scenario: Hide panel titles while retaining access to additional commands: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:97:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide panel titles while retaining access to additional commands ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon shows panel titles ✔ When the user opens the 3D Model tab context menu ✔ And the user clears Show Panel Titles ✔ Then the ribbon panel titles are hidden ✔ And the main panel commands remain visible ✔ And the Modify panel expansion arrow remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the Modify panel expansion arrow ✔ Then the Modify additional-command area opens ✔ And the area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part, and Copy Object ✔ When the user opens the 3D Model tab context menu ✔ Then Show Panel Titles is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Show Panel Titles ✔ Then the panel titles return ✔ And the additional-command area closes
